'''Brother''' was a title given to all members of the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]], a society of [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] subservient to the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]].

==Usage==
On the misty [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], the title of "Brother" was used, regardless of actual kinship, as a form of address for a [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]], alone or followed by his first name.<ref name="Monster" />

==Notable clan brothers==
*Brother [[Viscus/Legends|Viscus]]
*Brother [[Feral/Legends|Feral]]
*Brother [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]]
*Brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage]]

==Behind the scenes==
This title first appeared in [[January]] [[2011]] in "[[Monster]]," the thirteenth episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]].
